Agent Name: **Planner**  
Step Number: **5**  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly analyzed the results provided by the WebSurfer. While the WebSurfer correctly retrieved the birth dates for José Echegaray y Eizaguirre (19 April 1832) and P. J. O'Rourke (14 November 1947), the Planner misinterpreted the data, swapping the birth years of the two individuals. This led to the erroneous conclusion that P. J. O'Rourke was born first, when in fact, José Echegaray y Eizaguirre was born earlier. The error stems from a failure to correctly parse and compare the birth years extracted by the WebSurfer.
